examples.text: In this Friday, June 1, 2018, photo, two boys help finish a chalk mural at Marshall Field Garden Apartments during the Art on Sedgwick annual art show in Chicago. The theme of the mural "We all live here" was conceived by artist Rich Alapack who has focused the public art project at schools and community centers. "It's really a simple message -- but things are so divided," Alapack says. He said the goal is to bring people together. "Sometimes art can do that better than conversation."
